user.title: Connect to Z-Wave Alarm
user.description: Enter the host and port of your Z-Wave Alarm service.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Z-Wave Alarm service.

abort.already_configured: This Z-Wave Alarm service is already configured.

keypad_chime.name: Play keypad chime
keypad_chime.description: Plays a chime sound on a keypad that supports it.

device_id.name: Keypads
device_id.description: The keypad devices to play the chime on.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: The chime sound to play; it must be one the keypad supports.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Playback volume from 0 to 99. The keypad's own volume is used when omitted.

set_lock_schedule.name: Set lock schedule
set_lock_schedule.description: Sets one Schedule Entry Lock schedule for a user. The user can only unlock the lock inside the schedule.

device_id.name: Locks
device_id.description: The Schlage lock devices to apply this to.

user_id.name: User
user_id.description: The lock user (code slot) the schedule belongs to.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The schedule slot to write; each user has a limited number per schedule type.

schedule_type.name: Schedule type
schedule_type.description: Weekday: one day of the week every week. Year day: one date range. Daily repeating: the same time window on chosen weekdays.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days of the week the window repeats on (daily repeating schedules).

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: When access begins (weekday and daily repeating schedules).

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: When access ends; must be after the start time (weekday schedules).

start.name: Start
start.description: When access begins (year day schedules). The lock stores two-digit years, so only 2000-2099 work.

end.name: End
end.description: When access ends; must be after the start (year day schedules). Only 2000-2099 work.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long access lasts after the start time, under 24 hours (daily repeating schedules).

clear_lock_schedule.name: Clear lock schedule
clear_lock_schedule.description: Removes one Schedule Entry Lock schedule from a user.

device_id.name: Locks
device_id.description: The Schlage lock devices to apply this to.

user_id.name: User
user_id.description: The lock user (code slot) the schedule belongs to.

schedule_type.name: Schedule type
schedule_type.description: The kind of schedule the slot holds.

set_lock_schedules_enabled.name: Enable or disable lock schedules
set_lock_schedules_enabled.description: Turns schedule enforcement on or off for one user.

device_id.name: Locks
device_id.description: The Schlage lock devices to apply this to.

user_id.name: User
user_id.description: The lock user (code slot) whose schedules to enable or disable.

get_lock_schedule.name: Get lock schedule
get_lock_schedule.description: Returns one schedule slot stored on the lock for a user; the schedule is empty when the slot is unused.

device_id.name: Locks
device_id.description: The Schlage lock devices to apply this to.

user_id.name: User
user_id.description: The lock user (code slot) the schedule belongs to.

schedule_type.name: Schedule type
schedule_type.description: The kind of schedule to read.

arm.name: Arm with bypass
arm.description: Arms the alarm, leaving the listed sensors out until the next disarm. A plain arm is refused while sensors are faulted; the error names them, and their ids go under Bypass.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: Sensor ids to leave out of this arming session (the ids the refused arm listed). Cleared on disarm.

source.name: Source
source.description: What requested the arm. Lock, schedule and cellular-backup sources bypass faulted sensors automatically.

panic.name: Raise panic alarm
panic.description: Raises a real alarm that sounds the siren and, per its type, requests police, fire or medical help. Use it for a panic button; it is not a test.

type.name: Type
type.description: Panic (police), fire, medical (no siren) or SOS.

service.name: Service
service.description: Which emergency service an SOS asks for. Ignored for the other types.

silence.name: Silence siren
silence.description: Mutes every sounding siren. The alarm stays open and keeps its response until it is disarmed. Refused when no siren is sounding.

set_siren.name: Enroll or update siren
set_siren.description: Treats a Z-Wave node as a siren, or changes an enrolled siren's kind, name or duration. Needs an administrator.

node_id.name: Z-Wave node
node_id.description: The node id of the siren.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds an outdoor siren sounds, 60 to 600 (default 180). Base and dome sirens are fixed at 600.

remove_siren.name: Remove siren
remove_siren.description: Stops treating a node as a siren.

node_id.name: Z-Wave node
node_id.description: The node id of the siren.

set_user_code.name: Set user code
set_user_code.description: Sets or replaces a person's code. Administrators only. The code is sent to the service and never stored or logged by Home Assistant, but an automation or script that sends it keeps it in its own configuration and traces. Returns lock_sync: for each enrolled lock whether the code reached it (synced) or not (failed, with the reason).

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The alarm user's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

code.name: Code
code.description: Exactly four digits, unique across the alarm.

confirm_code.name: Confirm code
confirm_code.description: The same code again. The service rejects the request when they differ.

clear_user_code.name: Clear user code
clear_user_code.description: Removes a person's code, so they can no longer arm or disarm with one. Administrators only. Also clears the code from every enrolled lock; returns lock_sync with each lock's result.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The alarm user's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

set_duress_code.name: Set duress code
set_duress_code.description: Sets an administrator's duress code. Entering it on a keypad disarms visibly but raises a silent duress alarm. Only administrators can have one. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The alarm user's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

code.name: Code
code.description: Exactly four digits, unique across the alarm.

confirm_code.name: Confirm code
confirm_code.description: The same code again. The service rejects the request when they differ.

clear_duress_code.name: Clear duress code
clear_duress_code.description: Removes an administrator's duress code. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The alarm user's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

create_installer.name: Create installer
create_installer.description: Creates an installer, who can arm and disarm for 48 hours and is then removed by the service. Returns the user id and when the access ends. Administrators only.

code.name: Code
code.description: Exactly four digits, unique across the alarm.

confirm_code.name: Confirm code
confirm_code.description: The same code again. The service rejects the request when they differ.

list_guest_schedules.name: List guest schedules
list_guest_schedules.description: Returns a guest's keypad schedules. A guest with none has unlimited access. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The guest's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

add_guest_schedule.name: Add guest schedule
add_guest_schedule.description: Limits when a guest's code works on the keypad: outside every schedule the keypad refuses to arm or disarm. Locks do not enforce schedules. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The guest's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week the schedule allows, at least one.

all_day.name: All day
all_day.description: Allow the whole day. Start and end are then not used.

start.name: Start
start.description: When access begins. Required unless all day.

end.name: End
end.description: When access ends. An end at or before the start is an overnight window.

time_zone.name: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone the times are in. Defaults to Home Assistant's, because the service may run in UTC.

update_guest_schedule.name: Update guest schedule
update_guest_schedule.description: Changes a guest's keypad schedule; only the fields you pass change. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The guest's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week the schedule allows, at least one.

all_day.name: All day
all_day.description: Allow the whole day. Start and end are then not used.

start.name: Start
start.description: When access begins. Required unless all day.

end.name: End
end.description: When access ends. An end at or before the start is an overnight window.

time_zone.name: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone the times are in. Defaults to Home Assistant's, because the service may run in UTC.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule (from list_guest_schedules).

remove_guest_schedule.name: Remove guest schedule
remove_guest_schedule.description: Removes a keypad schedule. A guest with no schedule has unlimited access. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: The guest's id, as shown in the Z-Wave Alarm panel.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule (from list_guest_schedules).

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns the alarm's history, newest first, with who did it and which device it concerned. Administrators only. Codes are never part of an entry.

event_type.name: Event types
event_type.description: Only these kinds, for example tamper or code_changed.

user_id.name: User id
user_id.description: Only events caused by this user.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only events at or after this time.

before.name: Before
before.description: Event id to page from: returns events older than it.

list_mode_schedules.name: List mode schedules
list_mode_schedules.description: Returns the schedules that switch the alarm's mode at set times. Administrators only.

add_mode_schedule.name: Add mode schedule
add_mode_schedule.description: Switches the alarm to a mode at a time on chosen days. Arming this way bypasses faulted sensors and is logged as done by the schedule. Refused if another enabled schedule would run at the same time. Administrators only.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it runs, in the schedule's time zone.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week it runs, at least one.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether it runs. Defaults to on.

time_zone.name: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone the time is in. Defaults to Home Assistant's, because the service may run in UTC.

update_mode_schedule.name: Update mode schedule
update_mode_schedule.description: Changes a mode schedule; only the fields you pass change. Pass enabled to turn it on or off. Administrators only.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it runs, in the schedule's time zone.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week it runs, at least one.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether it runs. Defaults to on.

time_zone.name: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone the time is in. Defaults to Home Assistant's, because the service may run in UTC.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule (from list_mode_schedules).

remove_mode_schedule.name: Remove mode schedule
remove_mode_schedule.description: Deletes a mode schedule. Administrators only.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule (from list_mode_schedules).

set_chirps.name: Set chirps
set_chirps.description: Turns the chirps sensors play on the base station and keypads on or off in a mode. Administrators only.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether sensors chirp in that mode.

set_sensor_chirp_tone.name: Set sensor chirp tone
set_sensor_chirp_tone.description: Chooses the tone the base station and keypads play when an intrusion sensor trips; none is silent. Administrators only.

sensor_id.name: Sensor id
sensor_id.description: The id of an intrusion sensor, as shown in the panel.

set_keypad_volume.name: Set keypad volume
set_keypad_volume.description: Sets the volume of the keypad's chirps, countdown tones and announcements, 0 to 99. The siren always sounds at maximum. Administrators only.

keypad_not_found.message: No Z-Wave Alarm keypad matches the selected target.

lock_not_found.message: No Z-Wave Alarm lock matches the selected target.

schedule_not_reported.message: {lock} has not reported its {kind} schedule slots yet. Wake it with a keypad touch and try again.

schedule_slot_out_of_range.message: {lock} has {slots} slots for this schedule type; slot {slot} does not exist.

no_single_entry.message: Codes can only be managed when exactly one Z-Wave Alarm service is set up.

code_not_four_digits.message: A code must be exactly four digits.

data_description.is_interior: Interior sensors are bypassed when armed Home.
data_description.quick_entry_supported: The lock at this entryway supports quick entry.

abort.sensor_gone: The service no longer lists this sensor.
